SEARCH
Module awtzero
Package awtzero

Class RenderInstance

java.lang.Object
awtzero.RenderInstance
public class RenderInstance extends Object
The RenderInstance class provides a simplified wrapper around a Graphics object for common 2D rendering operations such as drawing shapes, images, and text.

It acts as a lightweight rendering helper for use with AWT components like Canvas.
